Hi Glen,

Congrats on joining Versapay as CFO and on the strong momentum across your customer base. With rapid growth and new leadership, many companies see intercompany reconciliation sprawl that drags down finance efficiency. Our platform lets operations teams automate those manual, reconciliation‑heavy tasks, giving you cleaner data and faster close cycles. I’d love to show how we can support Versapay’s next phase of growth.

Best,
Zamp
